CRITICAL RENDERING CORRECTION: Output a perfectly SHARP flat vector-style logo sheet on a SOLID OPAQUE PURE BLACK (#000000) background. All mint shapes must be uniformly solid opaque #B1E1CA; white variants uniformly #EDF2F3. NO glow, NO bloom, NO blur, NO neon, NO haze, NO shadow, NO transparency in logo fills. Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original poster contact sheet for a private anime-memory-archive UI prototype. Create exactly EIGHT completely original hand-painted anime-film poster artworks, no text anywhere, no titles/logos/watermarks, no known franchise characters. Grid strictly 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal portrait 2:3 panels, overall image 4:3 ratio, edge-to-edge tiles with NO margins, gaps, dividers or frames. Each cell must be one complete distinct vertically composed poster. Reading order: 1 coastal summer railway, small young adult woman with short black hair wearing white loose shirt, deep blue sea and golden clouds; 2 purple moonlit city and young adult bicycle courier, mystery; 3 vast emerald forest with a tiny young adult traveler in a yellow coat; 4 warm amber sunlit café with a young adult reader at the window; 5 indigo space observatory over snowy mountains; 6 scarlet sunset over tall futuristic city, small young adult rooftop silhouette; 7 wind in a lush meadow with a red umbrella, quiet pale sky; 8 teal nighttime harbor lantern reflections with small white sailing boat. Visually varied teal/amber/lilac/blue/green palette, each individual cell has a strongly composed focal subject and beautifully lit atmosphere. Painterly 2D animation film background, crisp expressive illustration, subtle visual detail. Use the full area of each portrait panel. All eight illustrations original. Exact grid no gutters for UI presentation cropping.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: six original animation-film stills used as saved-memory demo scenes in a local UI prototype. Create exactly SIX original film-still illustrations in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, all cells equally wide, each individual panel 16:9 landscape. Overall sheet aspect ratio 8:3. No gaps, borders, margins, text, labels or logos anywhere. All six moments from the same original gentle coastal summer story, consistent young adult woman with short dark hair, loose white shirt and navy trousers when visible. Reading order: 1 high wide view of tiny train curving beside turquoise sea under immense warm cumulus clouds; 2 close view of a clear glass of iced tea on a wooden windowsill, sparkling afternoon ocean beyond; 3 young adult woman at empty coastal railway platform looking toward brilliant blue sea, wind in her hair; 4 overhead view of two handwritten postcards and a seashell on a sunlit café table, NO legible writing; 5 wide ocean sunset with coral horizon and a tiny ferry, reflective quiet water; 6 the same young adult woman at a nighttime train window with soft blue reflections and distant amber harbor lights. Detailed original 2D hand-painted animation-cinema aesthetics, believable light, lush texture, intentional negative space, emotionally quiet, no known franchise or real anime imagery. Exact equal six-cell grid with no separators for UI presentation cropping.
